title: Federal Register: Agency Information Collection Activities; Extension, Without Change: Employment Eligibility Verification (Form I-9)

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, DHS (via GovInfo / Federal Register)
reliability: Government document; the issuing agency is also the party imposing or administering the requirement.
findings: USCIS estimates 62,063,950 annual respondents for Form I-9 employers, with an estimated 0.35 hours per response.
USCIS estimates 62,063,950 annual employee respondents at 0.15 hours per response, and 27,200,000 recordkeeping respondents at 0.17 hours per response.
USCIS estimates a total annual hour burden of 35,655,796 hours and a cost burden of $0.
The notice is an extension without change of an existing collection.
limitations: Agency PRA estimates, not measured time; no breakdown by employer size.
Does not capture penalties, error rates or legal-review costs.
